summary: The closure receipt restates the closure facts beside the verified predicates. One store read, ReadWorkClosure, opens one read-only transaction and returns the pin beside the latest proposal problem, the proposal's excluded scope, the effective delivery artifact with the correction overlay applied, and the direct raised_from successors with their confirmed Linear keys. The single-column table gains four optional sections in a fixed order: problem, shipped artifact, one left-out row per excluded-scope entry, and one follow-up row per raised item; an empty section renders no row, so an old item keeps the pin-alone bytes. Prose rows hold one hundred twenty code points with the visible ellipsis while criterion labels keep sixty-four. record_proposal gains the optional out_of_scope prose list of zero to sixteen entries in the payload shape the implementation family's canonical source declares, with a defaulted additive column on workflow_proposal_records, and validation refuses the field for an item whose declared shape lacks it. The adapter keeps zero formatting logic.
title: The closure receipt restates the closure facts
